Class LessonStore

java.lang.Object
database.LessonStore
final class LessonStore extends Object

Title: LessonStore Class.

Description: Session-bound persistence used exclusively by the shared Database instance. VG01-04 implement Contributor stories 1, 2 and 4; VG05-07 implement experience story 3. Database synchronizes these calls on its one connection. Prepared conditional writes check current locks in the same SQL statement as the write. Experience changes lock the parent row and commit the parent/experience/member rows together, or roll back all of them.

Attributes: connection is the existing Foundations connection (no second database); session supplies the stable authenticated user ID, independent of mutable account caches. ownerUserId binds records to that immutable ID; usernames are display labels only, so renames and deleted/reused names never transfer a previous account's lessons.
